summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Financials tab (multi-period NOI/DSCR calculator) + Executive Loan Summary PDF feature. Backend: 19/19 tests PASSED (1 parse-doc 422 skipped — no client_files upload helper in this env; 404 branch covered). Frontend: verified end-to-end on scenario c4d98f0b — Financials tab renders, UW rate/amort/term inputs persist and cascade into the top metrics strip (DSCR 1.29, Debt Yield 10.05%), Add Period Manual flow creates a column, radio select updates NOI in header, delete confirms and removes the column, Executive Summary preview PDF opens (blob URL popup) and Save-to-Portal toast fires with the doc appearing in Documents tab. Package tab Occupancy dropdown has correct 'Owner-Occupied' / 'Non-Owner-Occupied' options and persists on reload.

design_issues.screen: Admin scenario detail — Package / Documents tabs
issues: Carry-over from iter 9 & 10: React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires from the ve-instrumented <option> children in Sel dropdowns (client dropdown line 547 and sponsor filter line 1102 in AdminScenarioDetail.jsx). Non-blocking — same defect flagged twice already.

action_items: Consider addressing the persistent <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning (recurring for 3 iterations). Likely from a build-time visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text in <span> — either whitelist <option> or unwrap the ve span for option children.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3386 — save-to-portal locates existing summary doc by label 'Loan Executive Summary' string. If a broker manually renames the doc or a future migration changes the label, a NEW row will be created on next save (orphan). Consider tagging with a stable field like `system_key='loan_exec_summary'` for lookup.

server.py:3392 — When inserting the new client_files row for the summary, `doc_id` is set to existing['id'] (if replacing) but for the fresh-create branch (line 3419-3421) an initial insert has doc_id=None then patched to doc_id afterwards. Fine, but the tiny window between insert and update leaves an orphan file_id if the subsequent db.client_docs.insert_one fails. Wrap in a transaction or reorder (create doc_id first, then insert file).

AdminFinancialsTab.jsx:154 — window.open(url, '_blank') for the preview PDF: some browsers block popups if not directly inside the click handler; the try/catch wraps an await before window.open, which can trigger popup blockers on the second click. Consider using a hidden <a target=_blank> click instead.
server.py exceeds 9000 lines — modular split remains overdue (flagged in iter 10).
seed_data_creation: Test periods created and cleaned up via teardown_class. Persistent side-effect: uw_assumptions on scenario c4d98f0b now set to rate=6.75/amort=360/term=60 (was intended per test), and property_info.occupancy_type ends as 'owner_occupied' after the frontend test. Loan Executive Summary doc pinned to top of that scenario (idempotent replace-on-rerun). No orphan data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_financials_summary.py -v`. Test file is self-cleaning. Uses /api/auth/login (not /api/portal/login as initially guessed). Preview-PDF popup validation in Playwright: blob: URLs may cause wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded') to time out even when the popup opens — verify popup existence via expect_popup() event alone. Ada parse-doc 422 (no-text file) branch was not exercised — would need an admin doc upload endpoint call chain; consider adding a helper in server.py or using an existing scenario doc upload API to complete coverage.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all specified functionality works. The one 'skipped' test (parse-doc 422 for text-less file) requires uploading a real client_files row which isn't trivially exposed via a JSON-only endpoint; the 404 branch on non-existent file_id covers the auth+lookup path.
